title: koanophyllon miragoanae
intro: Koanophyllon miragoanae, commonly known as "Cacho Negro" or "Black Bundle," is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, native to Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in the treatment of various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Koanophyllon miragoanae include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and show potential in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable species in traditional medicine.
